notes: General everyday family organization and planning content only. No personalized legal advice, no outcome promises, no invented law, no client stories. Scrapbook-style informative infographic direction (2026-09-14 revision, replacing the clean-editorial-photography direction): torn/layered paper, washi tape, photo corners, stitched edges, hand-drawn doodles and arrows, handwritten-looking annotations, tasteful and professional, not a craft blog. Each piece is a real infographic (numbered steps, checklist, or timeline), not a single-line message post. Palette still keyed to the approved 2026-09-12-sunburst-social deliverables (client-operations/clients/bok-law-firm/deliverables/2026-09-12-sunburst-social): cream #F6F0E5, deep teal #0A3139, aqua #8FD3D8, brass #C88B3A. Every prompt reserves the lower-right ~20% of the image width as a clean, uncluttered patch with no torn paper, tape, doodles, stitching, or shadow crossing it; generate.py composites the real logo there automatically (LOGO_PATHS in generate.py), never the model. Format is feed_portrait (1088x1360, 4:5) per slot, the best-performing Facebook feed ratio and room enough for an infographic. On-image copy kept under ~60 words per slot for phone-feed legibility. No em dashes in any on-image text.

slots.title: Monday Reset: 3 Papers to Grab
slots.prompt: Create a scrapbook-style informative infographic for a warm, approachable family law and mediation firm's weekly Facebook post, portrait orientation. Background is a warm cream/kraft paper scrapbook page with torn paper edges, a stitched fabric border like an embroidery hoop frame, and one strip of aqua #8FD3D8 washi tape crossing the top-left corner. Deep teal #0A3139 handwritten-style headline lettering, brass #C88B3A hand-drawn doodle arrows connecting three numbered items down the page like a checklist taped into a family planner. Each of the three items sits on its own small torn cream index card with a rounded photo corner, tied down with a short strip of brass or aqua washi tape, in a clear top-to-bottom reading order connected by a thin hand-drawn arrow. Card 1 shows a simple hand-drawn icon of a calendar page. Card 2 shows a hand-drawn icon of a small bell or reminder ribbon. Card 3 shows a hand-drawn icon of a single folded paper being filed into a folder. No people, no gavels, no scales of justice, no courtroom imagery. Small torn-paper tag near the top reads exactly MONDAY RESET. Large handwritten-style headline reads exactly Three papers to grab before Monday. Card 1 label reads exactly School calendar. Card 2 label reads exactly Appointment reminder. Card 3 label reads exactly One paper to file. Small handwritten line near the bottom-left reads exactly boklawfirm.com. Beneath it, smaller text reads exactly General information only. Not legal advice. Reserve the lower right corner, roughly 20 percent of the image width and a matching height, as a clean plain patch of background with no torn paper, tape, doodles, stitching, or shadow crossing it, for a logo to be added afterward. Tasteful, professional, mature scrapbook craft aesthetic suited to a law firm, not childish clip art. Strong mobile readability, clear numbered reading order, no extra invented text.
